title: Rotor barrels run red to white hot with an overheat lockout; the first wave cleared unlocks tank / sentry / map switching
context: Owner: give the Rotor barrels the red/white hot treatment, running too hot needs a cool-down, generous but realistic. The story was stuck after killing enemies with the sentry: make killing the first wave the next unlock, with view buttons to switch from tank to sentry to global view.
outcome: Heat per round with radiative cooling (content SENTRY_HEAT, core coolHeat/heatGlow, fx paintBarrelHeat on the Edge meshes under the ROTOR pivot, materials cloned per model); lockout at 1.0 until under 0.35; the optic shows HEAT % and OVERHEATED. Sized against the measured piloted cadence (about 15 rounds/s; a first cut at 0.045 per round locked after 25 rounds): 0.016 per round gives about ten seconds flat out and four and a half back. Beats: with all fodder spent and none standing, 'cleared' fires Isao's wave_cleared line and api.unlock('views'); the controller builds the TANK / SENTRY / MAP strip, with a new leavePilot that disposes the optic and hands the hull back. Acceptance drives the wave to cleared and clicks all three. Controller at 17,623.
alternatives: Heat by time held rather than per round: rejected, per round follows the cadence and applies to auto fire the same way.
Auto-targeting after the wave: deferred, a later beat.
evidence: headless probe: shots/heat/overheated over six samples at the first tuning, then the retune
npm test 92 (story-beats extended with a twelve-strong wave), npm run check
